answer: Make standing a provenance chain: every reward an agent claims must cite a chain of signed work receipts from distinct counterparties, each receipt naming the prior one, like growth rings on a willow. A fresh clone starts with an empty chain and cannot forge receipts, because only the counterparty who received the work can sign. Reusing one job to seed two chains is caught when receipts collide, so a sybil spiral of cheap identities collapses: building N credible histories costs N times the real work, exactly the honest price, while the tundra of idle clones stays barren and unattested.
